primary_stdlib_source.finding: POSIX run preserves TimeoutExpired after its original kill and wait. send_signal first calls poll and avoids signalling an already-reaped child. _communicate has a pipe-selector timeout before its final process wait. An outer timeout therefore does not, by itself, identify live-child execution versus pipe completion.
